checks.name: K1_free_level
checks.detail: omega = 0.9539392014 (16 dimensions), 0.9539392014 (reduced to W), FE-40: 0.9539392014; eight-fold (two-fold in W) with Krein signature (4, 4) [(1, 1) in W]; T_0..T_3 symmetric, T_4..T_7 antisymmetric, the compact rotations SU(2) x SU(2) commute with gamma^(0), gamma^(4), P_L, sigma16 and the Krein operator, 16 = (2,2) x 4

checks.name: K3_residuals_16
checks.detail: 83 converged solutions (the three regimes for G = 1e-6 ... 1 and the continuation between); lifted to sixteen dimensions the four orbitals have Krein charge -1 each and are Krein-orthogonal; largest relative residual of the 16-dimensional Kohn-Sham equation (with the mean field rebuilt from the lifted orbitals) and fold matching 2.2e-04 (central differences on the grid), of self-consistency (the reduced problem) 1.7e-07; no cap active

checks.name: K8_through_the_free_threshold
checks.detail: the repulsive mean field raises the level through the free continuum threshold omega = m_Psi = 1 at G = 0.371 (regime I) and G = 0.142 (regime II), and the state stays bound up to G = 1 (omega = 1.070393 and 1.259734 there): far from the fold the proper density saturates (the density decays at 6H to within 5.4e-04 and 1.0e-08 above the threshold), so the far mean field keeps the local mass above omega: in the computed cases a repulsive self-interaction does not dissolve the particles chi into the bulk (the saturation needs the warp, H > 0)

checks.name: K4_dilute_exponents
checks.detail: delta omega ~ G^p for G <= 1e-4: {'I': 'fit 1.000, predicted 1.000', 'II': 'fit 0.999, predicted 1.000', 'III': 'fit 0.515, predicted 0.500'} (predicted 1 for q_b > 3H/2, q_b/(3H - q_b) for q_b < 3H/2)

checks.name: K5_saturation_and_runaway
checks.detail: far from the fold the scalar density decays at {'II': '0.9000 vs 0.900', 'III': '1.7999 vs 1.800'} (6H: the proper density e^{6H|sigma|} n_s saturates); attractive self-interaction G = -1e-4, -1e-2 from the free state: regime I converges [True, True]; in regimes II and III, where the proper density of the free state grows away from the fold, the level search finds no Krein-negative level (['no Krein-negative level within 0.05 of 0.953905789967', 'no Krein-negative level within 0.05 of 0.949741472420']; ['no Krein-negative level within 0.05 of 0.954512658400', 'no Krein-negative level within 0.05 of 0.911383012824'])

checks.name: K6_higgs_portal_loop
checks.detail: the occupied orbitals have rho_hat_L0(0) = 0.15723848 > 0, equal to d omega_b/d mu_L = -mu_L/(4 omega_b) = 0.15724273 (Hellmann-Feynman) up to the relative difference 2.70e-05, the error 2.70e-05 of the trapezoidal normalisation on the grid; the Higgs portal alone binds the fold (c_Phi < 0), so kappa_H < 0; with kappa_H = -0.30 and G = 0.1 the joint loop converges in 12 iterations: the gas raises v_loc^2, mu_L = -0.874681 (from -0.60; -0.8571 if rho_hat_L(0) were proportional to q_b), and the level falls to omega = 0.91512441 (0.96723519 without the feedback)

checks.name: K7_equation_of_state
checks.detail: P/e (= q/e) at G = 1e-6: ['7.15e-08', '2.15e-07', '4.69e-05']; at G = 1: ['0.056', '0.137', '0.224']; positive (repulsive) and vanishing in the dilute limit: the chi gas is cold dark matter

checks.name: K9_weak_binding
checks.detail: q_b = 0.03 m_Psi (q_b/omega_b = 0.030, the direct-detection bound on the Higgs portal), H = 0.002 m_Psi (c_b^2 = 1.071): omega = 0.9995498987 from the 16-dimensional shooting (FE-40: 0.9995498987), first-order coefficient 0.012489; self-consistent shift / first order = ['0.99940', '0.99429', '0.94309'] for G = 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2 (approaching 1 as G -> 0), P/e = ['6.2e-07', '6.2e-06', '5.8e-05']: a dilute, weakly bound gas of chi is pressureless; its self-interaction shifts the orbital energy by 1.25e-02 m_Psi per unit G and the energy per particle by 6.24e-03 m_Psi (half of it: the orbital energy counts the interaction twice)
